# Feedbax

Feedbax is an open-source, Notion-backed feedback portal deployed to Cloudflare Workers.

## Documentation
- https://feedbax.dev/docs/introduction
- https://feedbax.dev/docs/getting-started
- https://feedbax.dev/docs/integrations/submission-api
- https://feedbax.dev/docs/operations/configuration
- https://feedbax.dev/docs/reference/guarantees
- https://feedbax.dev/docs/reference/version-0.2

## Public interfaces
- Portal: https://feedback.feedbax.dev
- Trusted submission: POST https://feedback.feedbax.dev/api/v1/posts
- Repository: https://github.com/jessequartey/feedbax
